grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: Pool Training Day
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力练习材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答问题。听力文本中包含了自然的对话和纠正，请仔细辨别。所有题目均为单选题或填空题，填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。判断题请根据原文选择True、False或Not Given。
transcript:
A: Hi, Mei. Are you coming to the pool training on Saturday?
B: I want to, but I have a problem. My swimsuit is too old. It has a hole.
A: Oh no. If you need a new swimsuit, you should buy one today. The sports shop closes at six.
B: I know. But I also need goggles. I can't see well in the water without them.
A: The shop sells goggles too. If you buy both, you will get a discount.
B: Really? That's good. But I'm worried about the training time. It starts at eight in the morning.
A: Don't worry. If you arrive late, the coach will let you join the next group.
B: OK. And what about the pool rules? Can I bring a water bottle?
A: Yes, you can. But you must not bring glass bottles. They are dangerous.
B: I see. I'll bring a plastic bottle. And a towel—I need a towel, right?
A: Yes, you should bring a towel. The pool doesn't provide towels.
B: Thanks. One more thing: if it rains, will the training be cancelled?
A: No, it won't. The pool is indoors. But if you feel sick, you must stay home.
B: Good to know. I'll sign up online now. The website is swimmingclub.com, right?
A: Yes. But you must sign up before Friday. After Friday, the list is closed.
B: OK. I'll do it today. Thanks for your help!
A: You're welcome. See you Saturday!

questions.explanation: 说话者建议Mei今天去买一件新的泳衣。原文：'If you need a new swimsuit, you should buy one today.'

questions.explanation: 说话者说游泳池不提供毛巾。原文：'The pool doesn't provide towels.' 因此游泳池不提供任何东西。

options: The training will not be cancelled.
answers: The training will not be cancelled.

questions.evidence: But you must sign up before Friday.

grammar.title: 第一条件句与情态动词建议
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句用来谈论将来可能发生的事情及其结果。结构是：If + 一般现在时，主语 + will + 动词原形。例如：If you arrive late, the coach will let you join the next group. 情态动词 should 用来提建议，must 表示必须做某事。
grammar.example: If you need a new swimsuit, you should buy one today.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，主句用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If you arrive late, the coach will let you join the next group.

questions.prompt: You ___ bring a towel; it is not optional.
questions.explanation: must 表示必须做某事，因为不是可选的。

questions.prompt: If you feel sick, you ___ stay home.
questions.explanation: must 表示必须做某事。原文：'if you feel sick, you must stay home.'
questions.evidence: if you feel sick, you must stay home.

questions.prompt: You ___ sign up online before the 10th. (advice)
